about.detail: I'm Christian MacMillan, I was born in Mallorca in 1990 and have always been fascinated by design and tech. I studied a BS in Software Engineering, but soon I realized I was drawn towards more creative ways of implementing software. Three years ago, after living in different cities and working in some of the most creative and recongnized agencies, like B-Reel or Vasava, I decided to go solo. After years of freelancing, I grow into a full-service development studio to meet with my clients needs. We are a remote team designed to scale on a project basis. Easygoing, open minded, easy to collaborate with, and always willing to learn new skills in different areas.

testimonials.quote: Working with Christian means happy clients. He’s an all-round developer with problem-solving and leadership skills. The cherry on top is his great eye for design and animation, a hard-to-find quality in a dev that always help our projects shine. Always on my team!
testimonials.author: Xavier Cussó

testimonials.quote: The life of my business would end without my website. I trust Christian with my life. In addition to world-class developer skills, he brings a level of insight, empathy, and collaborative-ness that makes him the perfect partner on our projects.
testimonials.author: Stanley Tate

testimonials.quote: When best quality meets deadlines! He has a really good eye for detail which makes it a pleasure for designers to work with him. Also, he delivers full solid projects with the latest tech and features always in time with the smoothest workflow, efficiency to the max!
testimonials.author: Xavier Escala

testimonials.quote: Working with Christian is always a pleasure. He is very detail-oriented and ensures that the design is elevated with high-quality animations. His keen eye for design consistently brings our projects to life, and communication with him is effortless. He takes the time to thoroughly understand the project and asks the right questions, which is incredibly important and helpful. Collaborating with him has always been a smooth and enjoyable experience
testimonials.author: Esteban Piacentino
